title: BEAUTIFULLY RENOVATED APARTMENT IN MARINA DE PUENTE ROMANO
summary: A stunning first-floor apartment that has undergone a beautiful renovation and is situated in the tranquil Andalusian Garden of the prestigious Marina de Puente Romano. With breathtaking garden and pool views, this contemporary apartment offers a luxurious lifestyle that is synonymous with coastal resort living. The interior design of the apartment is sophisticated, incorporating the finest materials to create a refined and tranquil atmosphere. The open-plan layout maximises the use of space, while the modern design and carefully curated colour palette add to the calming yet luxurious ambiance. With its outdoor dining area and chill-out zone, Ficus 21 is the perfect spot to enjoy Marbella’s exceptional climate and the classic elegant lifestyle acquired only on the Golden Mile.
